free_design.Place: A covered courtyard at a neighborhood mending exchange, with an old hand-crank sewing machine and shallow drawers of spare buttons.
free_design.Activity: She searches for a matching button for an inherited sleeve after setting her removable oversmock on the peg to keep the fabric clear of the machine.
free_design.Pose: Facing toward the viewer and leaning lightly onto a high counter, she sorts a copper button with her right hand and steadies the detached sleeve with her left.
free_design.Framing: A vertical thigh-up front portrait with both hands visible and soft grey daylight from the open courtyard.
free_design.Outfit: An opaque ink-blue lingerie-inspired camisole with scalloped guipure trim and a plunging V neckline, with high-waisted moss satin tap shorts. Her separate work oversmock hangs from a peg beside the machine.
